import json, subprocess
def run(text):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submission/main.py'], input=text.encode(), capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode().strip()

vals = ["a]}{[", "b\\'x", "c\"d", "e\nf", "\\u0041", "[]{}"]
req = {
 "version":1,"window":1,
 "schema":[{"name":"f","type":"ID","values":vals}],
 "atoms":[{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f","at":0},"right":{"const":"a]}{[","type":"ID"}}],
 "policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
 "train":[{"id":"tr","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":["a]}{["]}]}],
 "probes":[{"id":"pr","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":["b\\'x"]}]}],
 "queries":[]}
txt = json.dumps(req)
print('brackets-in-strings:', run(txt))
req2 = json.loads(txt)
req2['train'][0]['rows'][0]['values'] = ['[[[[[[[[']
print('deep-string:', run(json.dumps(req2)))

def nestreq(n):
    chain = {}
    cur = chain
    for i in range(n-1):
        cur['n'] = {}
        cur = cur['n']
    return {"version":1,"window":1,"schema":[{"name":"f","type":"FLAG"}],"atoms":[],
            "policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
            "train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[],"zz":chain}
print('nest 63 (depth 64 total):', run(json.dumps(nestreq(63)))[1])
print('nest 64 (depth 65 total):', run(json.dumps(nestreq(64)))[1])
print('nest 62 (depth 63 total):', run(json.dumps(nestreq(62)))[1])
# object nesting via arrays
def nestarr(n):
    a = []
    cur = a
    for i in range(n-1):
        cur.append([])
        cur = cur[0]
    return {"version":1,"window":1,"schema":[{"name":"f","type":"FLAG"}],"atoms":[],
            "policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
            "train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[],"zz":a}
print('arr nest 63:', run(json.dumps(nestarr(63)))[1])
print('arr nest 64:', run(json.dumps(nestarr(64)))[1])
# raw control char in string -> invalid JSON
print('ctrl char:', run('{"version":1,"x":"a\nb"}')[1])
# lone surrogate escape
print('lone surrogate in unused key value:', run('{"version":1,"window":1,"schema":[{"name":"f","type":"FLAG"}],"atoms":[],"policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[],"zz":"\\ud800"}')[1])
# very large int where int expected
print('huge int version:', run('{"version":123456789012345678901234567890}')[1])
# 1e-400 underflow -> finite float -> schema error later
print('underflow:', run('{"version":1e-400}')[1])
